original_ai_prompt: Our single office needs internet. It has to come in over the DSL line, and at the same time over the cable modem, bonded together into one link. Security also wants the ASA firewall in front, and it has to be a 5505.
cleaned_prompt: Our single office needs internet. It has to come in over the DSL line, and at the same time over the cable modem, bonded together into one link. Security also wants the ASA firewall in front, and it has to be a 5505.
expected_behaviour: ONE definite issue the model must surface: the request demands DSL and cable 'bonded together into one link', which is not an expressible access shape (InternetIntent.access is exactly one of wan/dsl/cable, src/network_autopilot/ai/intent.py:237; no bonding shape exists), so the model must say so by name and must not fake a bonded link or silently pick one access type. Everything else is satisfiable: a single office with one inside network is exactly the single inside/outside perimeter an ASA 5505 supports, so no topology question is required. Correct response: surface the bonding contradiction, ask which single access type to use, and accept the 5505.
